# Twitch

4 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 4 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/twitch/clip - 1 credit (standard)

Get Twitch clip details

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Post · **Pagination** none

Returns detailed information about a specific Twitch clip including the title, view count, duration, creator name, broadcaster name, game name, thumbnail URL, and creation timestamp.

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Twitch clip · e.g. `https://www.twitch.tv/ninja/clip/ExampleClipSlug`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/twitch/clip?url=https://www.twitch.tv/ninja/clip/ExampleClipSlug" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/twitch/profile - 1 credit (standard)

Get Twitch streamer profile

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 900s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Author · **Pagination** none

Returns public profile information for a Twitch streamer including display name, follower count, bio, profile image URL, broadcast language, and partner/affiliate status.

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Twitch username · e.g. `ninja`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/twitch/profile?handle=ninja" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/twitch/user/schedule - 1 credit (standard)

Get a Twitch user's stream schedule

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** Analytics · **Pagination** none

Returns the upcoming stream schedule for a Twitch user: each entry includes start time, end time, title, description, and thumbnail URL.

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Twitch username. · e.g. `kaicenat`

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/twitch/user/schedule?handle=kaicenat" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/twitch/user/videos - 1 credit (standard)

List a Twitch user's videos

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 600s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** single page - Fixed-window feed: upstream returns a single non-cursored result set.

Fetches up to 100 videos for a Twitch user: id, slug, URL, embed URL, title, view count, language, duration in seconds, game info, broadcaster details with follower count, thumbnail URL, and available video qualities.

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Twitch username. · e.g. `ishowspeed`
- `filter_by` (optional, enum: HIGHLIGHT | UPLOAD) - Filter the returned videos by type: `HIGHLIGHT` or `UPLOAD`. (Archived past broadcasts are not currently available upstream.)
- `sort_by` (optional, enum: TIME | VIEWS) - Sort order: `TIME` (newest first) or `VIEWS`.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/twitch/user/videos?handle=ishowspeed" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
